v2.1: Fix privacy issues per ClawHub security audit - remove local config reading, message now timestamp only, add privacy notices to all docs, fix multi-line message format
OpenClaw 2026.7+ compatibility: fix event handling, shell injection, async I/O, CLI arg separation, python3 dependency check. Stable release.

## What's New

This release adds full compatibility with OpenClaw 2026.7+ and fixes critical security issues from v1.x.

### Highlights

- ✅ Compatible with OpenClaw 2026.7.1-2+
- 🔒 Shell injection prevention (exec → execFile)
- ⚡ Non-blocking async file I/O
- 🛡️ CLI_BIN + CLI_ARGS array separation (handles spaces in addresses)
- 🐍 Python3 dependency check with install hint
- 📊 Port auto-detected from openclaw.json config
- ⏱️ 10s timeout on notification command
- 🌐 ICU locale fallback for Linux environments

### Breaking Changes

- Requires OpenClaw 2026.7.1-2 or later
- Python 3.6+ required for setup script

### Upgrade from v1.x

```bash
git pull
scripts/setup_gateway_notify.sh <your-channel> <your-address>
openclaw gateway restart
